description: Fix frontend bugs and add all missing frontend features: dedicated logs page with pagination, campaign analytics page, template management UI, campaign edit/duplicate functionality, contact validation UI, export button, schedule sending UI, email body preview expansion, and improve the progress page with more detailed stats.
steps: Update frontend/src/lib/types.ts: Add interfaces for EmailTemplate, TemplateCreate, AnalyticsData, PaginatedLogs, SchedulePayload. Update existing types if needed.

Update frontend/src/lib/hooks.ts: Add hooks for all new backend endpoints - useTemplates, useCreateTemplate, useUpdateTemplate, useDeleteTemplate, useCampaignAnalytics, useDuplicateCampaign, useUpdateCampaign, useValidateContacts, useExportCampaign, useScheduleCampaign, usePaginatedLogs. Fix existing hooks if they have issues.

Rewrite frontend/src/app/logs/page.tsx: Replace the current implementation that reuses dashboard stats (only 8 logs) with a proper paginated logs page that uses the new GET /api/logs endpoint. Add pagination controls (prev/next buttons), search/filter by status, and proper timestamp formatting.

Create frontend/src/app/templates/page.tsx: A template management page with a list of saved templates, create/edit/delete functionality using dialog modals. Include fields: name, description, category, subject_template, body_template. Show template variables available.

Create frontend/src/app/campaigns/[id]/analytics/page.tsx: A campaign analytics dashboard showing delivery metrics, success rates, timeline of sends, and a breakdown of statuses in a visual format (using colored bars/stats cards).

Update frontend/src/app/campaigns/[id]/preview/page.tsx: Add a body preview expansion (click to expand full email body in the table), add a 'Validate Emails' button that calls the validation endpoint, add 'Schedule Send' button with a date/time picker dialog, improve the Gmail account selector UX.

Update frontend/src/app/campaigns/page.tsx: Add a duplicate button next to delete for each campaign, add an edit button that navigates to an edit page or opens a dialog. Add status filter dropdown. Add search by campaign name.
Create frontend/src/app/campaigns/[id]/edit/page.tsx: A page to edit campaign settings (name, prompt template, tone, length, temperature, delay) - only available for Draft/Generated campaigns.

Update frontend/src/app/campaigns/[id]/progress/page.tsx: Add export button to download results as CSV, show delivery rate percentage, add auto-scroll to latest log, improve the stats panel with more metrics.
Update frontend/src/components/sidebar.tsx: Add 'Templates' navigation item with appropriate icon.
Update frontend/src/app/settings/page.tsx: Add a section showing current rate limits (from environment), add ability to configure NVIDIA model selection (display only since it's env-based).
Update frontend/src/app/profile/page.tsx: Show more detailed stats including total contacts processed, average emails per campaign, most used template.
Add a frontend/src/components/ui/select.tsx shadcn select component using @radix-ui/react-select (already in package.json dependencies) for consistent dropdowns across the app.
Add a frontend/src/components/ui/progress.tsx shadcn progress component using @radix-ui/react-progress (already in package.json) for the progress bars.
Ensure all new pages and components follow the existing dark theme glassmorphism design pattern with proper animations (animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-4 duration-500).
acceptance_criteria: Frontend builds without TypeScript errors: npm run build succeeds
All new pages are accessible via their routes
The logs page shows paginated results with navigation controls
Templates page allows full CRUD operations on email templates
Campaign analytics page displays meaningful metrics
Campaign list has working search, filter, duplicate, and edit actions
Preview page has email body expansion, validation button, and schedule dialog
Progress page has export button and improved stats
All new UI components follow the dark theme design system
Select and Progress shadcn components are properly created
verification: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
